body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within 4 units maintaining an ordinary restraint, or any enemy in range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 Necrotic Damage and suppress one ordinary restraint it maintains on you or a willing ally until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: A freed willing creature may move 1 unit.
End that restraint rather than suppress it if it is ordinary and magical.

rider.title: Full Manifestation - Phantom
rider.html: You may burn 3 Action Dice and spend 2 Mana to enter Phantom Full Manifestation (FM-1P). It replaces you; use its profile. Dice, Resources, Movement spent and recorded injuries do not refresh.
